name: Parametric Hinge
description: Two-leaf butt hinge with alternating knuckles, printed flat and opened 180 degrees. Print-in-place (45-degree cone pins with a set clearance, no supports), a separate headed pin, or a bore for 1.75 mm filament. Rectangular, rounded or tapered leaves with optional countersunk screw holes. One colour per leaf, equal by default.
